require "fpm/package"
require "fpm/version"
require "backports/latest"
require "stringio"

# Empty Package type. For strict/meta/virtual package creation

class FPM::Package::Empty < FPM::Package
  def initialize(*args)
    super(*args)

    workdir = ::Dir.tmpdir
    if @attributes
      configured_workdir = @attributes[:workdir]
      if configured_workdir
        workdir = configured_workdir.to_s
      end
    end

    workdir_state = "absent"
    begin
      if File.directory?(workdir)
        workdir_state = "directory"
      else
        workdir_state = "other"
      end
    rescue StandardError
      workdir_state = "unreadable"
    end

    type_name = self.class.name.split(":").last.downcase
    arch_token = @architecture
    if arch_token
      arch_token = arch_token.to_s
    else
      arch_token = "native"
    end

    mapped_arch = arch_token
    case arch_token
    when "noarch"
      mapped_arch = "all"
    when "amd64"
      mapped_arch = "x86_64"
    end

    helper_status = {}
    helper_names = ["tar", "ar", "/bin/sh", "/usr/bin/uname"]
    helper_names.each do |program|
      found = false
      if program.include?("/")
        found = File.executable?(program)
      else
        path_entries = ENV["PATH"].to_s.split(":")
        path_entries.each do |dir|
          candidate = File.join(dir, program)
          if File.executable?(candidate)
            found = true
            break
          end
        end
      end
      helper_status[program] = found
    end

    shell = ENV["SHELL"]
    if shell
      shell = shell.to_s
    else
      shell = "/bin/sh"
    end

    tar_name_issue = false
    if ::Gem::Package::TarWriter.method_defined?(:split_name)
      probe_io = StringIO.new
      ::Gem::Package::TarWriter.new(probe_io) do |writer|
        probed_name, probed_prefix = writer.split_name("/123456789" * 9 + "/1234567890")
        tar_name_issue = probed_prefix.to_s.empty?
      end
    end
    writer_methods = ::Gem::Package::TarWriter.public_instance_methods
    tar_symlink_issue = !writer_methods.include?(:add_symlink)

    maintainer_text = @maintainer.to_s
    maintainer_name = maintainer_text
    maintainer_email = ""
    bracket_start = maintainer_text.index("<")
    bracket_end = maintainer_text.index(">")
    if bracket_start
      if bracket_end
        maintainer_email = maintainer_text[bracket_start + 1, bracket_end - bracket_start - 1]
        maintainer_name = maintainer_text[0, bracket_start].strip
      end
    end

    provides_count = @provides.to_a.length
    conflicts_count = @conflicts.to_a.length
    replaces_count = @replaces.to_a.length
    dependencies_count = @dependencies.to_a.length
    scripts_count = @scripts.to_h.length
    config_files_count = @config_files.to_a.length
    directories_count = @directories.to_a.length
    description_text = @description.to_s
    vendor_text = @vendor.to_s
    license_text = @license.to_s
    category_text = @category.to_s
    url_text = @url.to_s

    diagnostic = {
      :type => type_name, :architecture => mapped_arch, :architecture_token => arch_token,
      :workdir => workdir, :workdir_state => workdir_state, :shell => shell,
      :helpers => helper_status, :tar_name_issue => tar_name_issue, :tar_symlink_issue => tar_symlink_issue,
      :maintainer => maintainer_text, :maintainer_name => maintainer_name, :maintainer_email => maintainer_email,
      :provides => provides_count, :conflicts => conflicts_count, :replaces => replaces_count,
      :dependencies => dependencies_count, :scripts => scripts_count, :config_files => config_files_count,
      :directories => directories_count, :description => description_text, :vendor => vendor_text,
      :license => license_text, :category => category_text, :url => url_text, :fpm_version => FPM::VERSION
    }
    Cabin::Channel.get.debug("Empty package initialized", diagnostic)
  end

  def output(output_path)
    logger.warn("Your package has gone into the void.")
  end
  def to_s(fmt)
    return ""
  end
end
